# eDesigr.com

> Premium domain name for sale: edesigr.com. A one-word-category .com positioned at the intersection of electronic design and generative AI creativity. Listed at $195,000 USD, escrow-protected transfer.

edesigr.com reads instantly as "electronic designer". It is aimed at AI art platforms, digital design agencies, generative artists, AI copy + design tools, creative tech startups, and serious digital-art projects.

## Key facts

- Domain: edesigr.com
- Status: Available for acquisition (one buyer only)
- Asking price: $195,000 USD, one-time
- Category: Premium domain name / digital real estate
- Payment: Licensed escrow (Escrow.com or Dan.com), installment plans available for qualified buyers
- Transfer time: typically 3–10 business days
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com
- Owner-based sale (no broker fee for the buyer)
